title: Money and the Size of Transactions
title_zh: 货币与交易规模
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consumers make transactions of different sizes over time. This paper shows that this fact, together with transaction costs of various assets, can help in developing a theory of liquidity. Assets with different cost structures are used to purchase different sizes of transactions. This can explain the demand for money itself, the precautionary demand for money, and the demand for cash and demand deposits. Thus consumers use cash for small transactions, demand deposits for larger transactions, and use savings for the largest transactions. Finally, the paper shows that modeling banks as suppliers of liquidity leads to a better understanding of their success as financial intermediaries.
abstract_zh: 消费者在不同时间进行不同规模的交易。本文表明，这一事实与各类资产的交易成本相结合，有助于发展流动性理论。具有不同成本结构的资产被用于购买不同规模的交易。这可以解释货币本身的需求、预防性货币需求以及现金和活期存款的需求。因此，消费者使用现金进行小额交易，使用活期存款进行较大额交易，并使用储蓄进行最大额交易。最后，本文表明，将银行建模为流动性提供者有助于更好地理解其作为金融中介的成功之处。

title: DP1520 Hedging and Gambling: Corporate Risk Choice when Informing the Market
title_zh: DP1520 对冲与赌博：信息披露情境下的企业风险选择
authors: Richard Zeckhauser, François Degeorge, Boaz Moselle, Richard Zeckhauser; François Degeorge; Boaz Moselle
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyses corporate risk choice when firms and their managers have private information regarding firm quality. Managers ? representing themselves or shareholders ? have a short time horizon and wish to boost the firm?s reputation in the market. Investors observe the firm?s current earnings to assess firm quality. Each firm has an opportunity locus for trading off risk and expected return. We show that even risk-neutral managers will choose risk strategically to influence market perceptions. Our model employs the following sequence: (1) a manager learns the firm?s type (good or bad), which determines its opportunity locus relating to risk and expected return; (2) the manager selects a level of risk; (3) a period payoff is reaped; (4) potential purchasers of the firm draw inferences from the period payoff; and (5) the firm is sold in a competitive auction. If firms? choices of risk are observed by the market, pooling behaviour results. Among the pooling equilibria, we show that good firms prefer those with lower variance, which reveal more information, whereas bad firms prefer higher variance equilibria. If risk level choices can only be partially observed, as we expect, and if the market has no strong prior belief about whether firms are good or bad, then good firms will hedge and bad firms will gamble. The latter seek to masquerade as good firms; good firms in turn seek to distinguish themselves. If the market?s prior beliefs are highly unfavourable (favourable), both types gamble (hedge) hoping to alter (avoid refuting) these beliefs. Our empirical evidence confirms our theoretical results when risk choices are not fully observed. Firms with higher returns on assets have less variable performance.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了当企业及其管理者拥有关于企业质量的私人信息时，企业的风险选择行为。管理者——无论是代表自身还是股东——具有短期视野，并希望提升企业在市场中的声誉。投资者通过观察企业当前收益来评估企业质量。每个企业都面临风险与预期收益之间的权衡机会集。研究表明，即使是风险中性的管理者也会策略性地选择风险以影响市场认知。我们的模型采用以下顺序：（1）管理者获知企业类型（优质或劣质），该类型决定了其风险与预期收益的机会集；（2）管理者选择风险水平；（3）获得期间收益；（4）企业潜在购买者根据期间收益进行推断；（5）企业通过竞争性拍卖出售。若市场可观测到企业的风险选择，则会产生趋同行为。在趋同均衡中，优质企业偏好方差较低的均衡（能揭示更多信息），而劣质企业则偏好方差较高的均衡。若风险水平选择仅能被部分观测（如预期所示），且市场对企业优劣无强烈先验信念，则优质企业会进行对冲，劣质企业会进行赌博。后者试图伪装成优质企业，而优质企业则力求区分自身。若市场先验信念极为不利（有利），则两类企业均会赌博（对冲），以期改变（避免否定）这些信念。当风险选择未被完全观测时，我们的实证证据证实了理论结果：资产收益率较高的企业，其业绩波动性较低。

title: Policy Thresholds as Growth Barriers: Theory and Evidence from a Payroll Tax Notch
title_zh: 政策门槛作为增长障碍：来自工资税断点的理论与证据
authors: Sami Jysmä, Youssef Benzarti, Jarkko Harju
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Discrete policy thresholds are pervasive in tax and regulatory systems and can substantially distort behavior. We show that notches acting as barriers to mobility within a distribution generate distortions extending far beyond the threshold. The same mechanism biases conventional difference-in-differences estimators, and we propose a new methodology to recover causal effects. Applying the method to the abolition of a size-based payroll tax notch, we find that the notch reduced the number of firms above the threshold by 18 percent and lowered treated firms’ employment, capital stock, and value added by 10 percent, whereas conventional difference-in-differences estimates imply negligible effects.
abstract_zh: 离散政策阈值在税收和监管体系中普遍存在，并可能显著扭曲行为。我们证明，作为分布内流动性障碍的阈值缺口所产生的扭曲效应远超阈值本身。同一机制会导致传统双重差分估计量产生偏误，为此我们提出一种恢复因果效应的新方法。将该方法应用于基于企业规模的工资税缺口废除案例，我们发现该缺口使阈值以上企业数量减少18%，并导致受处理企业的就业、资本存量和增加值下降10%，而传统双重差分估计显示的影响可忽略不计。

title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations
title_zh: 平滑诊断性预期
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Cosmin Ilut, Hikaru Saijo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010）对 Kahneman 和 Tversky（1972）所提出的代表性概念的形式化，与不确定性和过度反应之间存在内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性扭曲信念留下的空间更小。平滑诊断性预期为调查数据的若干关键特征提供了统一且简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、在更长期限上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实，即不确定性越高，过度反应越强。一个结合平滑诊断性预期的解析性真实经济周期模型，既能解释调查数据中的过度反应和过度自信，也能解释商业周期的三个显著特征：不对称性、宏观波动的逆周期性以及微观波动的逆周期性。

title: When France’s Légion d’honneur awards move stock prices: A market signal of political access
title_zh: 法国荣誉军团勋章授予引发股价波动：政治准入的市场信号
authors: Stéphane Benveniste, Renaud Coulomb, Marc Sangnier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: State honours are designed as symbols of merit and public recognition. But they may also convey information with economic value. This column explores the market value of the Légion d’honneur. When corporate directors of French listed firms receive the honour, their companies’ share prices rise. This market reaction is concentrated among directors without a publicly observable educational link to members of the incumbent government before the award. The pattern suggests that state distinctions can provide investors with new information about a director’s potential access to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 国家荣誉旨在作为功绩和公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得该荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中在那些在获奖前与现任政府成员没有公开可观察的教育关联的董事身上。这一模式表明，国家荣誉能够为投资者提供关于董事接触政策制定者可能性的新信息。

title: Language Barriers in Multinationals and Knowledge Transfers
title_zh: 跨国公司中的语言障碍与知识转移
authors: Louise Guillouët, Amit K. Khandelwal, Rocco Macchiavello, Madhav Malhotra, Matthieu Teachout
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study communication frictions within multinationals (MNCs), hypothesizing that language barriers reduce management knowledge transfers within the organization. A distinct feature of such MNCs is a three-tier hierarchy: foreign managers (FMs) supervise domestic managers (DMs) who supervise production workers. Tailored surveys from our setting—MNCs in Myanmar—reveal that language barriers impede interactions between FMs and DMs. A first experimental protocol offers DMs free English courses and confirms that lowering communications costs increases their interactions with FMs. A second experimental protocol that asks human-resource managers at domestic firms to rate hypothetical resumes reveals that multinational experience and, specifically, DM-FM interactions are valued in the domestic labor market. Together, these results suggest that reducing language barriers can improve transfers of management knowledge, an interpretation supported by improvements in soft skills among treatment DMs in the first experiment. A model in which communication within MNCs is noncontractible—a realistic feature of workplace life—reveals that the experimental results are consistent with underinvestment in language training and provide a rationale for policy intervention.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了跨国公司内部的沟通摩擦，假设语言障碍会减少组织内部管理知识的转移。这类跨国公司的一个显著特征是三级层级结构：外籍经理（FMs）监督本地经理（DMs），而本地经理则监督生产工人。基于缅甸跨国公司的定制调查显示，语言障碍阻碍了外籍经理与本地经理之间的互动。第一项实验方案为本地经理提供免费英语课程，并证实降低沟通成本能增加他们与外籍经理的互动。第二项实验方案要求国内企业的人力资源经理对假设简历进行评分，结果表明跨国经验，特别是本地经理与外籍经理的互动，在国内劳动力市场中受到重视。综合来看，这些结果表明减少语言障碍可以改善管理知识的转移，这一解释得到了第一项实验中接受培训的本地经理软技能提升的支持。一个将跨国公司内部沟通视为不可契约化的模型——这是职场生活的现实特征——揭示了实验结果与语言培训投资不足的一致性，并为政策干预提供了理论依据。

title: Canst Thou Beggar Thy Neighbour? Evidence from the 1930s
title_zh: 汝能令邻国贫困乎？来自1930年代的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does an exchange rate depreciation depress trading partners’ output? I address this question through the lens of a classic episode: from 1931 to 1936, the largest economies in the world successively devalued their currency. In theory, the effect is ambiguous for countries that had not devalued: expenditure switching can lower their output, but the monetary stimulus to foreign demand might raise it. Newly constructed high-frequency devaluation shocks and a multi-country model disciplined by cross-sectional evidence concur. Contrary to the popular narrative in modern policy debates, devaluation did not dramatically lower the output of trading partners in this context. Meanwhile, devaluation substantially raised the output of the devaluing country itself: it was a potent stimulus, not a zero-sum game.
abstract_zh: 汇率贬值是否会抑制贸易伙伴的产出？本文通过一个经典历史案例来探讨这一问题：1931年至1936年间，全球主要经济体相继实施货币贬值。理论上，对于未贬值国家而言，其影响具有不确定性：支出转换效应可能降低其产出，但外国需求受到的货币刺激则可能提升产出。基于新构建的高频贬值冲击数据以及受横截面证据约束的多国模型，研究结果趋于一致。与现代政策辩论中的流行叙事相反，在此背景下，贬值并未显著降低贸易伙伴的产出。与此同时，贬值大幅提升了贬值国自身的产出：这是一剂强有力的经济刺激措施，而非零和博弈。

title: The Targets of Geoeconomic Coercion
title_zh: 地缘经济胁迫的目标
authors: Christopher Clayton, Matteo Maggiori, Jesse Schreger
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Great powers, like the United States and China, use existing trade and financial linkages of their economies to the rest of the world to exert geoeconomic power. The targeted entities include both foreign governments and foreign private firms. We characterize conditions under which a hegemonic country optimally targets private entities or their government in a given targeted foreign country. An advantage of coercing private entities is that they internalize less than their own government the equilibrium consequences of acquiescing to the hegemon's coercion. This allows the hegemon to build its power by exploiting the difference between the private cost to the targeted entity of the costly actions it demands and the social value to the hegemon of those actions. Coercing the government gives up some of this advantage, but offers the ability of having the targeted government potentially influence firms in its domestic economy that the hegemon finds valuable to coerce but for which it had limited direct coercive power. The relative strength of these two channels determines the optimal mix of coercion targeted at private entities and governments.
abstract_zh: 大国（如美国和中国）利用其经济与全球其他地区的既有贸易和金融联系来施加地缘经济影响力。其目标实体既包括外国政府，也包括外国私营企业。我们刻画了霸权国在特定目标外国中，最优选择针对私营实体或该国政府进行胁迫的条件。胁迫私营实体的优势在于：相较于目标国政府，私营实体对屈服于霸权国胁迫所产生的均衡后果内化程度更低。这使得霸权国能够利用其要求目标实体采取的高成本行动所产生的私人成本，与这些行动对霸权国的社会价值之间的差异来构建自身权力。胁迫政府虽会部分丧失这一优势，但能使目标国政府影响其国内经济中那些霸权国认为有价值胁迫、但自身直接胁迫能力有限的企业。这两个渠道的相对强弱决定了针对私营实体与政府的最优胁迫组合。

title: Networks paving the way: Apprenticeship, guilds, and access to mastership in early modern Genoa
title_zh: 网络铺路：近代早期热那亚的学徒制、行会与匠师资格获取
official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how kinship and professional networks shaped labour market outcomes in the guild‐based labour market of early modern Genoa. Using a newly constructed dataset of more than 8,000 apprenticeship contracts (1451–1530), I examine the extent to which family and guild connections influenced apprentices' chances of attaining mastership. Using a probabilistic record‐linkage strategy to reconstruct individual career trajectories, I show that apprentices embedded in kinship or guild networks were substantially more likely to become masters. These advantages operated through multiple channels, including shorter apprenticeship contracts and greater flexibility in training careers, and persisted even during periods of economic contraction, suggesting that apprenticeship in Genoa combined formally open access to training with strong informal mechanisms that structured advancement within skilled trades. The findings contribute to debates on the role of guilds and social networks in pre‐industrial labour markets, highlighting how institutions could simultaneously support skill formation and reproduce inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在近代早期热那亚的行会劳动力市场中，亲属关系与职业网络如何塑造劳动力市场结果。利用新构建的包含8000余份学徒契约（1451–1530年）的数据集，我考察了家庭与行会关系对学徒获得师傅资格的影响程度。通过采用概率性记录关联策略重建个体职业轨迹，我发现嵌入亲属或行会网络的学徒成为师傅的可能性显著更高。这些优势通过多种渠道发挥作用，包括更短的学徒契约期限和更灵活的职业培训路径，并且即使在经济收缩时期依然持续存在。这表明热那亚的学徒制度将正式开放的培训准入与塑造技能行业晋升路径的强有力非正式机制相结合。研究结论为关于前工业劳动力市场中行会与社会网络作用的讨论提供了新视角，揭示了制度如何同时支持技能形成并再生产不平等。

title: Universalization and the origins of fiscal capacity
title_zh: 财政能力的普遍化与起源
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 聚合元数据日期 2025-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity grounded in universalization reasoning. Citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which everyone acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived effectiveness of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens' moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak institutions.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于普遍化推理的税收遵从与财政能力模型。公民通过想象一个所有人行为相似的世界，部分内化隐瞒行为的后果，从而将自身的税收遵从决策与公共支出的感知有效性联系起来。自私的精英阶层在给定税收遵从水平的情况下，在公共品与私人租金之间进行选择。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并促使精英阶层将资源分配给公共品供给而非私人侵占。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德因素能够促成可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过提供公共品来传递自身类型信号，促使公民提高税收遵从度，并在同一时期内提升财政能力。因此，本文分析揭示了一条道德渠道——即便在制度薄弱的情况下，国家也可能通过该渠道摆脱低财政能力陷阱。
